name: @lanlens/mcp-server
description: Official MCP companion server for LanLens

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-tests/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:protocol: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-tests/test/protocol.test.js
scripts.mcpb:pack: npm run bundle && npm run mcpb:stage && mcpb pack build/mcpb build/lanlens-mcp-1.6.1.mcpb
scripts.mcpb:validate: npm run bundle && npm run mcpb:stage && mcpb validate build/mcpb/manifest.json
